title: Tie-dye, adire har ma da rini, an gwada da kuma lakabi
course_title: Babban Kayan Ado na Gida & Haɓakawa

say: Tie-dye, adire har ma da rini, an gwada kuma an yi musu lakabi.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don samfura huɗu na Babban Kayan Gida da Upcycling.

Launi akan kyalle yana tsakiyar kayan ado na Najeriya, daga kampala tie-dye zuwa adire na Yoruba. Dukansu suna aiki ta hanyar tsayayya: inda aka ɗaure masana'anta sosai, ƙarancin rini ya isa gare shi.

say: Za ku koyi tie-dyye, hanyoyin adire guda uku, har da rini na manyan yadi, da yadda ake gwadawa da lakabi aikinku.

say: Abubuwan rini na Fiber-reactive sun haɗa da auduga, lilin da rayon, amma ba polyester ba. Misali, Ifeoma a Onitsha tana yin rini shida farare 100% T-shirts auduga. Ta fara wanke su, don cire kayan aikin masana'anta.

panel.heading: T-shirts shida na Ifeoma
items: Kafin a wanke auduga 100% a cikin ruwan zafi
Jiƙa: 1 kofin soda ash a cikin kimanin lita 3.8
Juya karkace, ɗaure zuwa sassa 6
Rini: kimanin teaspoons 2 a kowace kofin ruwa
Kunna a cikin nailan; tsari 24 hours dumi

say: Ta narkar da ash soda kofi guda 1 a cikin ruwan dumi kimanin lita 3.8 sannan ta jika rigar na tsawon mintuna 20. Soda ash yana barin haɗin rini.

say: Ta murza kowace rigar cikin karkace, ta daura sassa 6, sannan ta matse koren da zinari, kowacce kamar cokali 2 a kowace kofin ruwa.

say: Adire shi ne rigar indigo na Yarbawa, wanda ya samo asali a Abeokuta, Ibadan da Osogbo. Oniko yana ɗaure tsaba ko tsakuwa cikin riga. Alabere yana dinka layin gudu, sannan ya ja su da karfi.

say: Eleko yana fenti rogo mai kauri mai kauri akan zanen, ko kuma ya baje ta ta stencil, sannan ya bushe sosai. Lokacin da kuke amfani da motif na gargajiya, yaba al'adar, ko mafi kyau, tsara naku.

say: Indigo launuka a cikin iska, ba a cikin wanka ba. Misali, Yewande a Abeokuta ta jika mai gudu da aka dinka ta kuma tsoma shi na kusan minti daya. Yana fitowa rawaya-kore.

panel.heading: Kore a cikin farantin, shuɗi a cikin iska
items: Daure ko rigar riga da farko
Narke a hankali; yana fitowa kore
Sanya shi har sai ya zama blue
Sake tsomawa don zurfin shuɗi

say: A cikin mintuna a cikin iska ya zama shuɗi. Ta maimaita na 4 dips gaba ɗaya. Dip ɗaya yana ba da shuɗin shuɗi, da yawa kuma suna ba da shuɗi mai zurfi na adire.

say: Sinadaran Vt suna da haɗari. Caustic soda yana haifar da ƙonewa mai tsanani. Saka tabarau, safar hannu na roba da dogon hannu, yin aiki a waje, kuma ƙara sunadarai a cikin ruwa sannu a hankali. Mafari na iya farawa da kayan aikin da aka shirya, ko aiki tare da ƙwararren mai rini.

panel.rule: Caustic soda A CIKIN ruwa, kada a taɓa ruwa akan soda.

say: Labulen da ya toshe yana da wuyar siyarwa. Da farko duba fiber. A cikin gwajin ƙonawa a hankali a waje, auduga yana wari kamar takarda mai ƙonawa kuma polyester yana narkewa cikin katako mai wuya.

panel.heading: Nneka yana rina murfi huɗu
items: Duba shi auduga ne, ba polyester ba
Nauyin bushe: 800 g
Ruwa 20: 1: 16 lita
Pre-jika, narke cikakke, motsawa akai-akai

say: Sa'an nan kuma yi aiki da nauyi. Misali, Nneka a Owerri yana da murfi guda hudu wanda ya bushe ya kai 800 g. Don matsakaicin inuwa tana amfani da 2%, wanda shine 16 g na rini.

say: A cikin rabo na 20 zuwa 1, tana buƙatar lita 16 na ruwa, don haka murfin zai iya motsawa da yardar kaina. Ta riga ta jika su, ta narkar da rini sosai, kuma tana motsawa akai-akai. Rina duk abubuwan da suka dace a cikin tsari guda.

say: Foda mai rini na iya harzuka huhu da haifar da rashin lafiyan jiki, don haka sanya abin rufe fuska yayin aunawa. Soda ash yana fusatar da fata da idanu, don haka sanya safar hannu. A ajiye kowane kofin rini da guga don rini kawai, ba don abinci ba.

panel.heading: Kura, guga masu nauyi da zubarwa

cards.d: Mashin kura lokacin auna foda, safar hannu don ash soda. Kayan kayan rini kawai, ba abinci ba.
Lita 16 tana auna kimanin kilogiram 16. Cika shi a inda kuke amfani da shi, ɗaga tare da durƙusa gwiwoyi, kiyaye zafi mai zafi daga yara.
Kar a taɓa shiga rafuka, magudanar ruwa, kusa da rijiyoyi ko rijiyoyin burtsatse, ko kan lambunan kayan lambu.

say: Guga mai lita 16 na ruwa yana kimanin kilo 16. Cika shi a inda za ku yi amfani da shi, kuma ku ɗaga tare da durƙusawa.

say: Gwada kowane tsari. A wanke swatch na tsawon minti 30 tare da ƙaramin farar auduga. Sai ki shafa busasshen, sannan ki shafa fari mai danshi a saman sama kamar sau 10. Launi akan farar kyalle yana nufin rini mara kyau.

say: Misali, Aisha a Kano ta yi rina rini na indigo guda 10, sai rigar da ke daure ta zama shudi. Ta jika su, ta wanke su da zafi sau biyu, sannan ta sake gwadawa.

say: Don tunawa. Yi amfani da masana'anta irin na auduga. Soda ash da 24 dumi hours gyara launi. Kurkura sanyi kafin a kwance. Yi aiki ta bushe bushe don ko da launi. Kuma gwada kowane tsari, sannan rubuta alamar kulawa a cikin kalmomi, ba kawai alamomi ba.

Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
